title: Banteay Srei & The River of a Thousand Lingas
description: Trek into the Kulen Mountains to witness complex Hindu carvings directly in the riverbed, before exploring Banteay Srei, the 'Jewel of Khmer Art'.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> * The "Banteay Srei & The River of a Thousand Lingas" experience is a 6-hour, full-day tour from Siem Reap, involving a 45-minute moderate jungle trek to Kbal Spean in the Kulen Mountains. This trek leads to thousands of lingas and images of Vishnu and Shiva carved directly into the riverbed.
> 
> * The tour features Banteay Srei, a 10th-century pink sandstone temple renowned for its intricate reliefs, considered the artistic peak of the Khmer Empire despite its miniature scale. Optimal viewing of Banteay Srei's glowing pink sandstone occurs in late afternoon light.
> 
> * This experience is categorized as "High" in physical demand due to jungle trekking in heat, making it suitable for fit travelers seeking a robust cultural day. Asia Golf Specialists (AGS) offers priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury SUV transfers for this year-round available tour.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Trek into the Kulen Mountains to witness complex Hindu carvings directly in the riverbed, before exploring Banteay Srei, the 'Jewel of Khmer Art'.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Banteay Srei, built of pink sandstone in the 10th century, is renowned for possessing the most intricate, deeply carved reliefs of any Angkorian temple—often said to be carved by women due to its delicacy. Kbal Spean, further up the mountain, represents a profound spiritual engineering feat: carving the riverbed to bless the water flowing to the capital.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Drive an hour north of Siem Reap. The experience begins with a moderate, 45-minute trek uphill through thick jungle to Kbal Spean. You witness thousands of lingas and images of Vishnu and Shiva carved directly into the rocks beneath the flowing river. 

Descending the mountain, you stop at Banteay Srei. The late afternoon light is required to make the pink sandstone glow. Your guide explains why this temple, despite its miniature scale, is considered the absolute artistic peak of the empire.

| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Artistic, Active, Remote |
| **Duration** | 6 Hours (Full Day) |

## Balancing Kbal Spean’s Jungle Trek With Siem Reap Championship Golf
Located 35 to 45 kilometers northeast of Siem Reap in the foothills of Phnom Kulen, **Banteay Srei & The River of a Thousand Lingas (Kbal Spean)** is the most physically active excursion in northern Cambodia, combining a 1.5-kilometer uphill rainforest trail over sandstone boulders with a private walk through the 10th-century pink-sandstone jewel of Banteay Srei. Because trekking in tropical humidity taxes the calves and lower back, Asia Golf Specialists positions this 6-hour expedition as a dedicated off-course adventure day—either the day after your opening round at [Phokeethra Country Club](/courses/cambodia/phokeethra/) or following your final tournament round at [Angkor Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/angkor-golf-resort/).

Departing [Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-grand-dangkor/), [Amansara](/accommodations/cambodia/amansara/), or [Jaya House River Park](/accommodations/cambodia/jaya-house-river-park/) at 07:00 AM in a climate-controlled Toyota Alphard ensures you reach the Banteay Srei carvings before the harsh midday light and complete the Kbal Spean forest ascent while the jungle canopy is still cool.

## Trail Timing, Hydration & Post-Trek Recovery
* **Seasonal Water Levels at Kbal Spean:** The riverbed carvings of thousands of Shiva *lingas* and reclining Vishnu figures are most dramatic between July and January, when clear mountain water cascades over the sculpted sandstone; during peak late-dry-season months (February–April), the exposed rock carvings remain visible in detail.
* **Cut-Off Gate & Footwear Protocol:** Park rangers close the Kbal Spean uphill trail at 3:00 PM sharp; our morning departure hits the trailhead by 9:30 AM, with trekking poles, cold coconut water, and deep-tissue spa appointments waiting back in Siem Reap by 1:30 PM.

faqs.q: How physically demanding is the hike to Kbal Spean (River of a Thousand Lingas) for golfers?
faqs.a: The Kbal Spean trail is a 1.5-kilometer (45-minute) uphill forest walk with rocky steps and tree roots. We schedule it on a non-golf day between rounds at Angkor Golf Resort and Phokeethra Country Club so your legs stay fresh for the fairways.

faqs.q: How far are Banteay Srei and Kbal Spean from central Siem Reap luxury hotels?
faqs.a: Banteay Srei is a 45-minute drive (37 km) northeast of Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor and Amansara via paved rural roads, with Kbal Spean located another 15 minutes further into the Phnom Kulen foothills.

faqs.q: When is the best time of day to photograph the pink sandstone carvings at Banteay Srei?
faqs.a: Early morning between 7:30 AM and 9:00 AM offers warm directional sunlight that illuminates Banteay Srei's deep 10th-century filigree reliefs while avoiding midday tour bus congestion.
